answer_4.quote: Firstly, we randomly sample 50 literal sentences from the test set and adopt the trained SG model to generate five candidates for each one. Then, for each perspective, three raters are asked to rate each simile from 1 to 5, where 1 denotes the worst and 5 denotes the best.
